name: Grainient · Ecliptic Gradients

title.zh: Grainient · 按纹理和合集比较背景

description.zh: 看Ecliptic具体光环预览，四张完整及四张局部。 Grainient按类别与合集展示渐变背景，本次实看噪点网格与Ecliptic光环渐变子集。Freebies与付费素材层分开，年费报价有冲突；素材终稿许可不等同程序源码许可或原文件再分发权。
description.en: Grainient presents gradient backgrounds by category and collection. The observed pages include a noisy texture grid and Ecliptic ring gradients. Freebies and paid assets have separate access conditions, annual pricing is inconsistent, and asset output permissions do not establish software source rights or unrestricted redistribution.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Grainient (https://grainient.supply/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看Ecliptic具体光环预览，四张完整及四张局部。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先在首页确认背景素材入口，再看噪点网格：当前十二张可见部分中只有中排四张完整。Ecliptic合集能看四张完整光环及下行四张局部，锁形标记与Pro入口仍在，本次未下载或验证动画、Shader。Freebies与付费素材层分开；年费报价存在冲突，素材终稿许可也不等同程序源码或原文件再分发授权。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
